title: I Wish I Could...
grammar: bárcsak + conditional; szeretném, ha + conditional matched to te/ő
goal: I can make an emphatic wish with bárcsak + conditional.
I can use szeretném, ha to wish for something about someone else, matching the conditional to te or ő.
I can talk about dreams and wishes coming true using álom and megvalósul.
I can use four new words for wishes and dreams.
